title: TaskAcceptance af/TaskAcceptance@1
$comment: A Task's structured acceptance (ADR-0255): the items its Task file's `acceptance` list states, in that order, each under the ID the evaluator judges it by. Captured at plan time, referenced from TaskRevisionV1.provenance.input_artifact_ids, carried verbatim in the Task's af/TaskCheckReceipt@2 and handed to the evaluator on a Pipeline's optional `acceptance` root port. A passing evaluation that does not name every item ID as a word of its `reason` does not verify the Task. Written only for a Task file that states acceptance.

items.description: One to 32 items, each ID once (the uniqueness of IDs is checked by the reader).

text.description: What the result must meet: nonblank, at most 4096 characters, without control characters but newline and tab.
